cohort: Three puerperal women (two multiparous, one primiparous) who presented with acute or chronic uterine inversion following childbirth.
finding: This case series reports three rare cases of puerperal uterine inversion (two chronic, one acute) that were successfully diagnosed and managed surgically with uterine preservation.
mod_finding: Two of the three cases of uterine inversion occurred after home deliveries, with one specifically mentioning the absence of a trained birth attendant.
